---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an extension, new model, additional metric, or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: souravmb, kashyapramakrishnan
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or extension you are proposing.

---

## Motivation

Why is this feature useful? What gap does it address?

- What limitation of the current implementation does this resolve?
- Is this supported by a paper, benchmark, or prior work? (provide references if so)

---

## Proposed Approach

Describe how you would implement this. Include:

- Algorithm or method name
- Relevant equations or pseudocode (if applicable)
- Python packages you plan to use
- Expected impact on RMSE / Precision@K / Recall@K (if measurable)

---

## Category

- [ ] New recommendation model (e.g., BPR, NCF, ALS, LightFM)
- [ ] New evaluation metric (e.g., NDCG@K, MRR, Hit Rate)
- [ ] Improved visualisation
- [ ] Reproducibility / environment improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

---

## Are You Willing to Implement This?

- [ ] Yes, I will open a Pull Request
- [ ] No, I am only suggesting the idea

---

## Additional Context

Any references, papers, notebooks, or related issues.
